name: background-jobs
description: Comprehensive guidance for background processing in the Mossback platform. Covers jobs, workers, queues, schedules, cron expressions, retries, backoff, dead letters, idempotency, concurrency limits, timeouts, job payloads, job priorities, long-running tasks, batch processing, and fan-out. Also covers how a job is defined, how it is enqueued from a request handler, how it is registered with the scheduler, how failures are surfaced, and how to replay a failed job safely.
